= ServiceNow
:artifactid: camel-servicenow-starter

Query and change records, attachments, import sets and service catalog items of a ServiceNow instance through its REST API.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::servicenow-component.adoc[ServiceNow component], URI syntax: `servicenow:instanceName`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-servicenow-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
